text.p: The following are some of the leading stories in Finnish papers this morning:

- Easing income tax in the next two years should be financed by selling state property, and part of public funds for research could be reallocated to taxpayers, says Teemu Lehtinen, managing director of the Taxpayers' Association.
- Finnish economic trends point to deflation in the future and investors should be aware, says Tom Liljestrom, CEO of pension insurer Elake-Tapiola. @
- Building material industry products sales booming, branch lobby says.
- Film advertising students get their own Masters degree.
NOTE - Most Finnish newspapers were not published on Friday due to the May 1 public holiday on Thursday.
